integrity: Finite checks use exact rational arithmetic and supplement an all-parameter mathematical proof. The matrix nonnegative-rank bounds and perturbation theorem are explicitly credited to earlier literature; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Type minimization applies to exact unthinned Poisson offspring reproduction with parent-independent latent-type mark-emission laws, not every imaginable graph-neighborhood encoding.
Strictly positive perturbation thresholds are existential; no numerical threshold or exact nonnegative rank is claimed.
Unboundedness is a known matrix phenomenon; the claimed contribution is the exact branching-representation correspondence and its sparse full-support consequence.
Historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain unverified.
title: Exact Poisson mark-type complexity is nonnegative rank: an unbounded-rank-three obstruction
